ArizeAxApiKey.title: Arize AX API Key
ArizeAxApiKey.x-credential-instructions: Create a user API key in Arize AX, then paste the key here without the Bearer prefix. Grant access to the spaces and resources your actions need. NoClick checks the key by listing accessible spaces.
